title: End-to-End Fix: Meals, Macros & Smart Recipes Slices (Backend + Frontend)
acceptance_criteria: Delete all mock data arrays and localStorage stores for nutrition targets, meals, and recipes.
MacroTrackerView loads live targets via GET /api/v1/nutrition/targets and updates targets via PUT /api/v1/nutrition/targets.
Implement GET /api/v1/meals in backend to fetch daily logged meals, and hook up MealHistoryList to render server data.
MealLogForm submits to POST /api/v1/meals/log with Idempotency-Key and recalculates daily macro budget from server response.
RecipeRecommendationView fetches ranked recipes from GET /api/v1/recipes/recommendations?householdId=...
1-Click Cook executes POST /api/v1/recipes/{id}/cook with real householdId and servings, atomically deducting FEFO stock in DB and returning remaining budget.
If ingredients are insufficient, backend returns 422 INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY and UI displays MissingIngredientsModal with exact shortfall.
